name: Olivia Campbell
original_name: オリビア・キャンベル
source:
An American exchange student and member of the basketball club.

A very cheerful and friendly person who is very intense when it comes to skinship. People around her tend to be little afraid her because everything about her large scaled.

She is a lot bolder than the other boarders and often walks around light dressed.
